subject: Package rstan for distribution while CRAN catches up?

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Package rstan for distribution while CRAN catches up?
parts:
Ben / Jonah / Jiqiang,

Would it be possible to create a distribution that includes StanHeaders and rstan for 2.10 while things are out of synch on CRAN?

We don't need it now, but it would be good for when we need to teach courses. This could hold onto all of boost, eigen, cvodes, and everything else and I could imagine it being downloaded and installed rather than installed over the web.

If this is possible, how much time do you need and how big would it be?


Thanks.




Daniel

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Package rstan for distribution while CRAN catches up?
parts:
On Thursday, May 26, 2016 at 5:26:55 PM UTC-4, Daniel Lee wrote:
Would it be possible to create a distribution that includes StanHeaders and rstan for 2.10 while things are out of synch on CRAN?

We already have planned for this:

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Transition-Periods

It just needs to update the URL for the Windows binary of rstan on winbuilder. Anyone else can install from source on GitHub.

Ben
